title: Business Central 2025 wave 2 (BC27): Cancel build and publish from Visual Studio Code
summary: Business Central 2025 wave 2 introduces the ability to cancel build and publish operations directly from Visual Studio Code, allowing developers to stop long-running processes and iterate faster without waiting for completion.
key_points: Developers can now manually cancel the build and publish processes in VS Code by pressing a Cancel button or closing the application
Cancellation is especially valuable for large extensions where build and publish times are lengthy, improving developer productivity
If connection to the development environment is lost, publishing automatically cancels to prevent blocking subsequent publish attempts
The feature is available in pre-release versions of the AL Language extension (v16.0.1743592 and v17.0.1750311)
features: Cancel build and publish from Visual Studio Code

quotes.text: developers can now cancel building and deploying an extension in Visual Studio Code
